question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 B 组：加拿大 vs 波黑（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group B: Canada vs Bosnia-Herzegovina (three-way result after 90 minutes)?
one_liner_cn: Elo 差约 193 分加主场之利让加拿大明显占优，但 Davies 缺席揭幕战，胜率下修至六成出头。
one_liner_en: A ~193-point Elo gap plus home advantage favors Canada, but with Davies out of the opener the win probability is revised down to the low 60s.

key_reasons.cn: 加拿大队长 Davies（左腿筋伤）预计缺席揭幕战，Marsch 称力争第 2/3 场复出，主队失去最强攻击点。
key_reasons.en: Canada captain Alphonso Davies (left hamstring) is expected to miss the opener; Marsch hopes he returns for group match 2 or 3, costing the hosts their biggest attacking threat.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 实力差显著：加拿大 1788（第 25）对波黑 1595（第 65），且加拿大作为东道主在多伦多主场作战（+100 修正）。
key_reasons.en: Large Elo gap: Canada 1788 (rank 25) vs Bosnia 1595 (rank 65), with Canada playing at home in Toronto as a host nation (+100 adjustment).

key_reasons.cn: 波黑热身赛进攻乏力（0-0 北马其顿、1-1 巴拿马），锋线依赖 40 岁的 Dzeko。
key_reasons.en: Bosnia's attack looked blunt in warm-ups (0-0 vs North Macedonia, 1-1 vs Panama), relying on 40-year-old Edin Dzeko up front.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, +100 host bonus for Canada group match at home) gave 67.3/20.3/12.5; bounded evidence adjustment of -4pp Canada / +2.5pp draw / +1.5pp Bosnia for Davies and Bombito absences vs Bosnia's blunt attack; renormalized to 63/23/14. No betting-market data used.
